rationale.conceptual: The paper presents a custom transfer-matrix method with perturbative expansion in external and effective fields up to second order for the square Ising model. Implementing it requires translating a non-standard RG approach with multiple interacting components (matrix factorization, perturbation tracking, fixed-point equations, critical exponent derivation) into code, demanding genuine understanding of the physics and the algorithm.
rationale.execution: The reproduction pipeline is linear: implement the transfer-matrix function, solve fixed-point equations for nine cluster triplets, compute exponents, extrapolate, and output a CSV. It uses only standard Python libraries and involves no external data, tooling, or multi-stage orchestration beyond a typical single-script workflow.
